adjacent_competitors.name: Spherity Product Pass
adjacent_competitors.reason: Circular-plastics material/product passport links supplier material passports and proof-of-origin/quality credentials, but is broader passport infrastructure rather than a lightweight procurement/quality claim desk.

competition_search_terms: recycled content traceability software plastics lot certificate
material passport recycled content claim supplier evidence
geri dönüştürülmüş içerik izlenebilirlik yazılımı plastik
results.market_gap: Lightweight UX is a possible positioning wedge, but recycled-content provenance and downstream claim proof are already directly productized.

results.first_customer_plan: Pilot with one converter using PCR/PIR compounds.
results.main_risk: Traceability incumbents and emerging DPP infrastructure already cover provenance.
results.validation_assumption: Circulor meets same-customer + same-job + substantially-same-workflow test.
results.local_applicability_rationale: Trakya applicability is plausible but no concrete Lüleburgaz plastics buyer evidence was verified in this chunk.
results.rejection_reason: Circulor already provides recycled-material traceability specifically to prove recycled-content claims downstream.
